method: Read900 additional contiguous lines of declarations, State, layout and startup. Static source review only.
findings: OCR jobs serialize under a process-global mutex with poison recovery. This narrows v38 concurrency finding but does not prevent old result overwriting a query edited while job runs; no publication generation id.

SearchRequest.query_id and State.current_query_id are usize. Reviewed publication masks to32bits, receiver compares against unmasked State value. After2^32 increments on64bit, equality can fail. No reset in read portions; remaining code unread, no long-run runtime fixture.
State has no final-received-query field, supporting same-id fast/final ordering gap. AI state has chat id/pending but no per-request generation; request serialization elsewhere remains pending.

visible_results divides positive layout limit by item_height directly cast from settings, without zero guard. Prior settings module has no range validation; later startup/reload normalization remains pending. No invalid user configuration loaded.
Main initializes STA COM before run, narrowing audio-helper initialization uncertainty for main-thread calls. Worker threads require their own initialization; no all-thread guarantee.

Legacy directory migration runs before single-instance enforcement and settings/extraction argument dispatch; ignores rename failure and does not merge into existing new directory. No user directories moved.
Extraction child entry point exists, but previously reviewed indexer extraction is a stub. Startup comment is not proof of PDF/DOCX extraction.

Icon cache limit constants are declarations, not evidence of eviction. Later loading/cleanup paths unread. Header comment about ignored errors is author rationale, not an instruction to skip our verification.
limits: 85/268 whole files; main.rs partial ranges only.
No runtime checks or production changes.
